title: Review Polytechnic Courses to Ensure They Stay Relevant to Industry Needs
what_it_is: Review Polytechnic Courses to Ensure They Stay Relevant to Industry Needs

sections.label: Diploma course curriculum reviews
sections.summary: Diploma course offerings are reviewed yearly, curricula every three years, and IT curricula more frequently due to fast-changing industry.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Every year, they review the range of their diploma course offerings and make changes to drop or start new courses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: In addition, every three years or so, they do an in-depth review of the curriculum of each course.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: For courses in sectors, such as information technology (IT), the curriculum is reviewed more frequently, given the fast-changing nature of the industry.

sections.label: Seven full-time courses retired
sections.summary: In 2017, seven full-time courses were retired due to low student interest and to better meet industry needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: In 2017, seven full-time courses were retired, partly due to a lack of interest from students, and partly to reposition them to meet the needs of industry better.
